description: Array the input N times — copy i steps by (Step X, Step Y) metres and Step Rotation°. The general parametric-count builder (e.g. a staircase run = one tread looped `steps` times along `going`).
instructions: Repeats its input geometry `count` times. Copy i is translated by (i·Step X, i·Step Y) metres and rotated i·Step Rotation° about the input's own centroid, so the copies form a linear (or spiralling) array. EVERY parameter is wireable (valin-*): drive `count` from an Input Properties `steps` value and `Step X` from `going` to build a straight staircase run in plan entirely from flow nodes — no 2D/3D render engine. Outputs every copy on one handle; wire onward or commit to draw the array.
